title: Father of Noah, three, thanks those who searched for his son as village reels from loss
summary_full: Rhys Woods says there are ‘no words’ for family’s pain after Noah’s body was found in pond near Suffolk playgroundThe father of Noah, the three-year-old boy who was found dead after going missing from a playground, has spoken of his heartbreak and thanked the community who launched a tireless search for his son.Rhys Woods said there were “no words to describe the pain of this loss”, adding that the family was “absolutely heartbroken”.
